entrance: The Defias Hideout, the large building in the southwest corner of Moonbrook at /way 42 72. The portal is at the bottom of the caves below it.

214.objective: Bring 10 Red Silk Bandanas. Every monster with Defias in its name can drop one, and the elites drop them almost every time.
214.note: Scout Riell offers it once you are working on the chain of The Defias Brotherhood.

shots.alt: A Defias Overseer and a Defias Evoker on patrol in the Deadmines, a screenshot from World of Warcraft
Defias Pirates on the docks of the cove in the Deadmines, a screenshot from World of Warcraft

168.objective: Collect 4 Miners' Union Cards from the undead in the haunted mine outside the dungeon: Undead Excavators, Skeletal Miners and Undead Dynamiters.
168.note: Every undead there is elite. Foreman Thistlenettle does not drop the cards.

shots.alt: Wilder Thistlenettle with a yellow exclamation mark in a tavern in Stormwind, a screenshot from World of Warcraft
The haunted part of the mine outside the Deadmines, with undead miners between the beams, a screenshot from World of Warcraft

92753.objective: Plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives by the forge in the room of Gilnid, then meet Alba Fairmoon at the exit of the Deadmines.
92753.note: New in Forever, the last step of a chain of seven quests. The chain is on this page, above the table.

167.objective: Kill Foreman Thistlenettle at the far end of the haunted mine and bring his Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle.
167.note: A level 20 elite among other elites. Do it together with Collecting Memories.

shots.alt: Foreman Thistlenettle among other undead at the end of the haunted mine, a screenshot from World of Warcraft

2040.objective: Bring the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, a drop from Sneed's Shredder, to Shoni the Shilent.
2040.note: The chain starts with Gnoarn in Tinker Town in Ironforge.

shots.alt: Shoni the Shilent, the quest giver of Underground Assault in Stormwind, a screenshot from World of Warcraft
Sneed's Shredder in the lumber camp of the Deadmines, a screenshot from World of Warcraft

166.objective: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
166.note: The last of six quests with the same name, which take you across Westfall, to Lakeshire and back.

shots.alt: Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall, a screenshot from World of Warcraft
Edwin VanCleef on the top deck of his ship in the Deadmines, a screenshot from World of Warcraft

373.objective: Bring An Unsent Letter, a drop from Edwin VanCleef, to Baros Alexston in City Hall at Cathedral Square in Stormwind.
373.note: The first step of a chain that continues in The Stockade.
